paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the change in loss over epochs for a training and validation dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" and spans from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and integer tick labels every 5 units. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and spans from 0.45 to 2.25 with a linear scale and tick labels every 0.25 units. A blue solid line, labeled "Train," begins at a value of approximately 1.93 at epoch 0 and decreases, reaching a value of approximately 0.48 at epoch 30. A green solid line, labeled "Validation," begins at a value of approximately 1.74 at epoch 0 and fluctuates, with a peak of approximately 2.11 at epoch 9 and a trough of approximately 1.01 at epoch 17, finally reaching approximately 1.06 at epoch 30.
